title: Adjoining independent variables to a fixed local power-series map
statement: Let c,n,e be natural numbers. Let Lambda_A and Lambda_B be commutative rings, with R=Lambda_A[[X_1,...,X_n]] and S_0=Lambda_B[[Z_1,...,Z_e]] regular local, and S_0 complete. If c=0, suppose Lambda_A is a characteristic-zero field and Lambda_B a field; if c≠0, suppose both are Cohen rings for c [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring]. Let phi:R→S_0 be local. Let t be the canonical list of the X variables if c=0, and c followed by these variables otherwise. Then S=Lambda_B[[Y_1,...,Y_n,Z_1,...,Z_e]] is complete regular local, and there are a surjective local map pi:S→S_0 and a local map h:R→S with pi h=phi, and a list z in S such that t.map h ++ z is a regular system of parameters [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters].

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NN, proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NN

proof.text: Apply power_series_field_cohen_regular_complete to Lambda_B and n+e. Extract regularity, completeness, and dimension n+e when c=0 or n+e+1 otherwise. The incompatible disjunct is excluded because a Cohen ring is a discrete valuation ring and is not a field.

Use j=Fin.natAddEmb n to construct pi=killCompl j and iota=rename j. Mathlib killCompl_rename_app proves pi iota=id and hence surjectivity; IsLocalHom.of_surjective proves pi local. Constant coefficients are preserved by rename, so the unit criterion proves iota local. The first n variables are killed by pi. Use the constant-coefficient kernel clause of quotient_first_variables, splitting F as C(constantCoeff F)+(F-C(constantCoeff F)), to express the maximal ideal of any finite-variable power series ring as the coefficient maximal ideal extended by C plus the variables ideal.

Set b_i=iota(phi(X_i))+X_(castAdd e i), which lies in the target maximal ideal by locality and the unit criterion for variables. Apply exists_unique_adic_evaluation with coefficient map iota phi C and variable values b to obtain h. Apply it again in S_0 with coefficient map phi C and values phi(X_i). Both phi and pi h agree on constants and variables. Any ring map carrying the variables into an ideal carries the N-th power of their span into the N-th power of that ideal, by Ideal.map_pow and monotonicity; this supplies their continuity. Uniqueness therefore gives pi h=phi. Since this composite is local, Mathlib isLocalHom_of_comp proves h local.

Take z to be List.ofFn of X_(j k). Let J be the span of t.map h ++ z. It contains each h(X_i), every Z variable, and, when c is nonzero, the natural-number cast c because ring maps preserve such casts. The coefficient maximal ideal is zero over a field and generated by c over a Cohen ring, so its image is contained in J. The maximal-ideal decomposition from step 2 shows that iota maps the maximal ideal of S_0 into J. In particular iota(phi(X_i)) belongs to J; subtracting this from h(X_i) gives Y_i in J. Fin.addCases accounts for every target variable, proving the target maximal ideal is contained in J. Conversely every list entry is in the maximal ideal by locality of h and the membership of c and the variables in the source maximal ideal. Thus J is the maximal ideal. List.length_map, length_append, and length_ofFn give length n+e or n+e+1, matching step 1. Unfold the definition of a regular system of parameters. The empty lists when n=0 or e=0 are handled by the same proof.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_power_series_parameter_perturbation
    {ΛA : Type u} {ΛB : Type v} [CommRing ΛA] [CommRing ΛB] (n e c : ℕ)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛA)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin e) ΛB)]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin e) ΛB))
      (MvPowerSeries (Fin e) ΛB)]
    (hzeroA : c = 0 → IsField ΛA ∧ CharZero ΛA)
    (hposA : c ≠ 0 → IsCohenRing c ΛA)
    (hzeroB : c = 0 → IsField ΛB) (hposB : c ≠ 0 → IsCohenRing c ΛB)
    (φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛA →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin e) ΛB) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (t : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛA))
    (ht : t = if c = 0 then List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n ↦ (X i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛA))
      else (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛA) :: List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n ↦ X i)) :
    ∃ (_ : IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + e)) ΛB)),
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + e)) ΛB))
        (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + e)) ΛB) ∧
      ∃ (π : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + e)) ΛB →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin e) ΛB)
        (h : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛA →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + e)) ΛB),
        Function.Surjective π ∧ IsLocalHom π ∧ IsLocalHom h ∧ π.comp h = φ ∧
        ∃ z : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + e)) ΛB),
          IsLocalRing.IsRegularSystemOfParameters (t.map h ++ z)
